items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: So that was John Hammond, whom I had the pleasure of talking with and really telling how much I appreciated his making that life possible.

ctx.x: Very strict. And he loved that free and easy way that the African Americans had at that time, and he wanted to be a part of it. And the way he could be a part of it, maybe in a little bit we’ll go to, I’d like to say that he, through John Hammond he got to be a part of it.
Oh I didn’t realize John Hammond had a part in getting Alfred on the road to recording.
